name: Distant Shores
source:
When you're swept back to the 18th century, you embark on a swashbuckling adventure led by a sexy pirate captain. But will you ever make it home?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Distant_Shores]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当你意外穿越回18世纪，你将在一位性感海盗船长的带领下踏上一场惊险刺激的航海冒险。但你究竟还能否重返现代故乡？
